sources.title: 《承政院日记》英祖五年八月七日：观象监购求历法书、再次派李世澄与官银册价问题
sources.provider: National Institute of Korean History, Seungjeongwon Ilgi
sources.quality_notes: Official online diplomatic transcript explicitly mentions the previous year's unsuccessful/incomplete acquisition, a renewed proposed mission for Li Shicheng and an expense request. This is about astronomical calendar books, not an observed Ziping edition, and the original Kyujanggak manuscript leaf was not viewed. Date is day of recorded proposal, not book printing or travel date.

sources.title: 《承政院日记》英祖九年七月二十日：安重泰在北京购历书、学算法及追述李世澄等官银购历
sources.provider: National Institute of Korean History, Seungjeongwon Ilgi
sources.quality_notes: Official day-list native Han text reports An Jung-tae learning from Qin Tian Jian official He Guoxun and procuring calendar books at private expense, and recalls earlier officials Kim Sang-beom, Heo Won and Li Shicheng as officially financed calendar procurers. It does not re-attest Yuanhai Ziping copies, establish textbook use, nor show original handwriting. Distinguish 1733 recollection from 1732 reported private Fangshu purchases.

unresolved_lineage_questions: Original folios corresponding to official 1729 and 1733 web transcripts have not been image-collated.
1732 diary day 10 precise official 14th article and original manuscript leaf remain unverified; independent Gehai Ziping book identity remains unresolved.
1710s–1740s calendar acquisition can be framed institutionally, not used to infer transfer of a specific Zi Ping textbook, algorithm, or impression.
